steps.title: Reach more people

how.title: Your whole gym in one app
how.sub: What you need to open with no one at the front desk and know what's happening at any moment.

rows.title: Members get in with their phone
rows.text: Each member gets in with the QR code in their app. If you prefer, also by face, with a wristband or through a turnstile. We help you choose at the visit.
rows.alt: QR access code in the member app

rows.title: They pay in the app
rows.text: They sign up and pay by card or Bizum at any time, or at the desk. Each payment buys its period and members see in the app until when they can get in.
rows.alt: Member's membership with its end date

rows.title: You control everything
rows.text: From your phone you see this month's revenue, who's inside right now and what each employee has charged, and you know when your team comes in and leaves.
rows.alt: Owner panel with this month's revenue

rows.title: Nobody sneaks in
rows.text: A 3D sensor counts everyone who walks through. If two people get in on a single entry, an alarm sounds in the gym and the person who opened the door is recorded.
rows.alt: Sensor screen with entries, exits and alarms

how.more: Plus shop, classes, workouts, live occupancy and smart building controls.

faq.title: Your questions, answered
items: Do I need to be a limited company to have the app under my brand?
No. Your app carries your logo, colours and name whether you're a sole trader or a company.
We measure your premises, study the floor plan and advise you on what hardware to install and where. It's free.
By card or Bizum in the app, through the Redsys banking gateway, or at the desk in cash or by card terminal. Each payment buys an access period.
How do I stop people sneaking in?
The 3D sensor counts everyone. If more people pass than entries granted, an alarm sounds and the person who opened the door is recorded. With a camera, every alarm is saved on video.
What if the power or internet goes down?
With the Complete pack, a UPS and a 4G router keep the door working.
Yes. Role-based access and encrypted connections, and each member only sees their own data. If you use face recognition, we give you the data protection paperwork and a non-biometric option.
It depends on what your gym needs. After the visit we give you a fixed, tailored price.
